FM15.reasoning: The agent evaluates the model using only accuracy without checking the target distribution, which is problematic since the car evaluation dataset is highly imbalanced.

FM07.reasoning: The agent only applies basic ordinal and one-hot encoding to the raw columns, without generating any derived features or interaction terms.

other_failure_modes.name: Independent One-Hot Encoding of Train and Test Sets
other_failure_modes.description: Applying one-hot encoding (e.g., `pd.get_dummies`) separately to the train and test sets can lead to a mismatch in the number and order of columns if the sets contain different unique categories. This causes models to fail during inference due to misaligned features.

summary: The agent sets up a solid cross-validation framework and applies ordinal encoding effectively using the known ordinal values of the car dataset. However, it fails to perform any substantive feature engineering beyond basic encoding, relies solely on accuracy for an imbalanced dataset, and introduces a critical risk of feature misalignment by applying `pd.get_dummies` independently to the train and test sets for non-ordinal columns.
